name: Mgbakọ na Mwepụ Kwa Ụbọchị maka Ọrụ na Ndụ
objectives: Mgbe e nyere gị fraction, decimal, percent na eriri ntụle, ịgbanwe n'etiti fraction, decimal na percent ma gụọ eriri ntụle ruo 1/8 inch kacha nso, ma nweta opekata mpe 4 n'ime 5 ziri ezi
Mgbe e nyere gị ọnụahịa, ụgwọ ihe i riri ma ọ bụ ọnụ ụgwọ ọrụ, ịgbakọ mbelata ọnụahịa, ụtụ isi ahịa, tip ma ọ bụ mmụba ụgwọ site n'iji percent, ruo cent kacha nso
Mgbe e nyere gị nha abụọ nke otu ngwaahịa na ọnụahịa ha, ịgbakọ ọnụahịa otu unit nke ọ bụla ma họrọ nke ka mma ịzụ, ma họrọ nke ziri ezi opekata mpe na 4 n'ime ụzọ 5
Mgbe e nyere gị ọrụ dị ka ịtọ ala ime ụlọ ma ọ bụ idekọ oge ọrụ, ịgbanwe unit ma gbakọọ area ma ọ bụ awa ọrụ, na unit ziri ezi, na-agbago elu mgbe ị chọrọ ihe zuru ezu
Mgbe e nyere gị paystub, ilele awa, ọnụ ụgwọ, overtime, ihe e wepụrụ na net pay otu ahịrị n'otu ahịrị, ka ahịrị ọ bụla dabara ruo cent, ma ọ bụ dee mperi ahụ ka ị jụọ maka ya
Mgbe e nyere gị ụgwọ ọrụ na-abịa mgbe niile, ịhazi budget kwa ọnwa nwere ego nchekwa ma mee ka mmefu ghara ịgafe ego na-abata, ka e dee ụdị mmefu ọ bụla ma lelee mkpokọta

chapters.name: Isi 1: Ọnụọgụ ị na-eji kwa ụbọchị

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 1: Fraction, decimal, percent na eriri ntụle
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 1 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Gbanwee n'etiti fraction, decimal na percent ma gụọ eriri ntụle.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị fraction, decimal, percent na eriri ntụle, ị ga-enwe ike ịgbanwe n'etiti fraction, decimal na percent ma gụọ eriri ntụle ruo 1/8 inch kacha nso, ma nweta opekata mpe 4 n'ime 5 ziri ezi.
Fraction, decimal na percent bụ ụzọ atọ e si ede otu ọnụọgụ ahụ. Ọkara pizza bụ 1/2, ma ọ bụ 0.5, ma ọ bụ 50%. Otu ụzọ n'ime anọ bụ 1/4, 0.25 ma ọ bụ 25%. Ụzọ atọ n'ime anọ bụ 3/4, 0.75 ma ọ bụ 75%.
Iji gbanwee fraction ka ọ bụrụ decimal, kee ọnụọgụ dị n'elu site n'ọnụọgụ dị n'ala: 3/8 bụ 3 kere 8, nke bụ 0.375. Iji gbanwee decimal ka ọ bụrụ percent, bugharịa ntụpọ decimal ebe abụọ gaa n'aka nri: 0.375 bụ 37.5%. Iji si n'percent gaa na decimal, bugharịa ya ebe abụọ gaa n'aka ekpe: 15% bụ 0.15.
Eriri ntụle na US na-egosi inch ọ bụla kere ụzọ 16 site n'obere akara. Akara kacha ogologo n'etiti inch bụ 1/2. Akara na-esote n'ogologo bụ 1/4 na 3/4. Mgbe ahụ 1/8, 3/8, 5/8 na 7/8. Ndị kacha nta bụ ụzọ iri na isii (sixteenths). Ọ bụrụ na eriri ahụ akwụsị akara 3 nke 1/8 gafere 5, ọ na-agụ 5 na 3/8 inch.
Ịgbakọ fraction nwere otu ọnụọgụ n'ala dị mfe: gbakọọ ndị dị n'elu ma hapụ nke dị n'ala. 1/8 + 3/8 = 4/8, nke bụ otu ihe ahụ na 1/2.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Fraction gaa na decimal: kee nke elu site na nke ala.
- Decimal gaa na percent: bugharịa ntụpọ ebe 2 gaa n'aka nri.
- Percent gaa na decimal: bugharịa ntụpọ ebe 2 gaa n'aka ekpe.
- Eriri ntụle: chọta inch zuru ezu, wee gụọ akara gafere ya.
- Mee ka ọ dị mfe: 4/8 bụ otu ihe ahụ na 1/2.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Fraction: otu akụkụ nke ihe zuru ezu, e dere ọnụọgụ n'elu na ọnụọgụ n'ala, dị ka 3/4.
- Numerator: ọnụọgụ dị n'elu fraction: akụkụ ole ị nwere.
- Denominator: ọnụọgụ dị n'ala fraction: akụkụ ole hà nhata na-eme ihe zuru ezu.
- Decimal: ọnụọgụ nwere ntụpọ, dị ka 0.75, na-egosi akụkụ nke ihe zuru ezu.
- Percent (%): akụkụ n'ime 100. 25% pụtara 25 n'ime 100.
Nwaa ugbu a: Omume (azịza dị n'okpuru): (1) Dee 1/4 dị ka decimal na percent. (2) Dee 0.6 dị ka percent. (3) Dee 8% dị ka decimal. (4) Gbanwee 5/8 ka ọ bụrụ decimal. (5) Gbakọọ 1/4 + 1/4. Azịza: (1) 0.25 na 25%; (2) 60%; (3) 0.08; (4) 0.625; (5) 2/4, nke bụ 1/2. Ọ bụrụ na i nwere eriri ntụle ma ọ bụ rula, tụọ ihe 3 n'ụlọ ruo 1/8 inch kacha nso.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịgbanwe n'etiti fraction, decimal na percent ma gụọ eriri ntụle ruo 1/8 inch kacha nso.

check.why: 3 kere 4 bụ 0.75, ịbugharị ntụpọ ebe abụọ gaa n'aka nri na-enye 75%.
Bugharịa ntụpọ ebe abụọ gaa n'aka ekpe: 6% = 0.06.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 2: Mbelata ọnụahịa, ụtụ isi ahịa, tip na mmụba ụgwọ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 2 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Gbakọọ mbelata ọnụahịa, ụtụ isi ahịa, tip na mmụba ụgwọ site n'iji percent.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ọnụahịa, ụgwọ ihe i riri ma ọ bụ ọnụ ụgwọ ọrụ, ị ga-enwe ike ịgbakọ mbelata ọnụahịa, ụtụ isi ahịa, tip ma ọ bụ mmụba ụgwọ site n'iji percent, ruo cent kacha nso.
Iji chọta percent nke ọnụọgụ, gbanwee percent ahụ ka ọ bụrụ decimal ma mụbaa. 20% nke $45 bụ 0.20 x 45 = $9.
Mbelata ọnụahịa (discount): wepụ ya n'ọnụahịa. Jaketị $45 nke e belatara 20% na-efu 45 - 9 = $36. Ụtụ isi ahịa (sales tax): tinye ya. Ọ bụrụ na ọnụ ụtụ isi bụ 8%, ụtụ isi na $36 bụ 0.08 x 36 = $2.88, ya mere ị ga-akwụ $38.88. Ọnụ ụtụ isi ahịa dị iche na steeti na obodo ọ bụla; lelee ụlọ ọrụ ụtụ isi steeti gị ma ọ bụ lee akwụkwọ nnata ego (receipt).
Tip n'enweghị kalkuleta: chọta 10% site n'ibugharị ntụpọ otu ebe gaa n'aka ekpe, wee wulite site na ya. Na ụgwọ $28, 10% bụ $2.80, 5% bụ ọkara ya, $1.40, ya mere 15% bụ $2.80 + $1.40 = $4.20. 20% bụ 10% ugboro abụọ: $5.60.
Mmụba ụgwọ (raise): mmụba 3% na $16.00 kwa awa bụ 0.03 x 16 = $0.48, ya mere ọnụ ụgwọ ọhụrụ bụ $16.48 kwa awa. Lezie okwu anya: "20% off" pụtara na ị na-akwụ 80% nke ọnụahịa; "20% more" pụtara na ị na-akwụ 120%.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Gbanwee percent ka ọ bụrụ decimal.
- Mụbaa ya na ego ahụ.
- Mbelata: wepụ. Ụtụ isi ma ọ bụ tip: tinye. Mmụba ụgwọ: tinye ya n'ọnụ ụgwọ ochie.
- Mee ka ego ruo cent kacha nso.
- Lelee: azịza ahụ ọ dabara? Mbelata ga-adị obere karịa ọnụahịa.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Mbelata ọnụahịa (discount): ego e wepụrụ n'ọnụahịa.
- Ụtụ isi ahịa (sales tax): ụtụ isi a na-agbakwunye n'ọnụahịa mgbe ị na-akwụ ụgwọ; ọnụ ya dabere na steeti na obodo gị.
- Tip: ego mgbakwunye ị na-enye maka ọrụ e mere gị, a na-agbakọkarị ya dị ka percent nke ụgwọ.
- Mmụba ụgwọ (raise): mmụba n'ọnụ ụgwọ ọrụ gị.
- Ime ka ọ ruo (round): ime ka ọnụọgụ dị mfe; a na-eme ka ego ruo cent kacha nso.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- Federation of Tax Administrators: State tax agency links (n'asụsụ bekee)
Nwaa ugbu a: Omume (azịza dị n'okpuru): (1) Akpụkpọ ụkwụ ọrụ $60 nwere mbelata 25%. Gịnị bụ ọnụahịa ya ugbu a? (2) Ụtụ isi bụ 7% na ihe $50. Gịnị bụ mkpokọta? (3) Chọta tip 20% na ụgwọ $35. (4) Ọnụ ụgwọ gị $15.50 nwetara mmụba 4%. Gịnị bụ ọnụ ụgwọ ọhụrụ? Azịza: (1) $45; (2) ụtụ isi $3.50, mkpokọta $53.50; (3) $7.00; (4) $0.62 karịa, $16.12 kwa awa. Wee lee ezi akwụkwọ nnata ego (receipt) ma chọta ọnụ ụtụ isi ebe obibi gị nara.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịgbakọ mbelata ọnụahịa, ụtụ isi ahịa, tip na mmụba ụgwọ ruo cent kacha nso.

check.q: Uwe oyi $80 nwere mbelata 25%. Gịnị bụ ọnụahịa ya ugbu a?

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 3: Ọnụahịa otu unit: ịchọta nke ka mma ịzụ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 3 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Gbakọọ ọnụahịa otu unit ma họrọ nke ka mma ịzụ.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị nha abụọ nke otu ngwaahịa na ọnụahịa ha, ị ga-enwe ike ịgbakọ ọnụahịa otu unit nke ọ bụla ma họrọ nke ka mma ịzụ, ma họrọ nke ziri ezi opekata mpe na 4 n'ime ụzọ 5.
Ọnụahịa otu unit (unit price) bụ ọnụ otu unit: otu ounce, otu pound, otu mkpụrụ. Ọ na-enyere gị aka ịtụnyere nha dị iche iche n'ụzọ ziri ezi. Iji chọta ya, kee ọnụahịa site n'ọnụọgụ unit.
Ihe atụ: igbe cereal ounce 24 na-efu $4.80. $4.80 / 24 = $0.20 kwa ounce. Igbe ounce 36 na-efu $6.12. $6.12 / 36 = $0.17 kwa ounce. Igbe nke ka ukwuu bụ nke ka mma ịzụ.
Nke ka ukwuu anaghị adị ọnụ ala mgbe niile. Akpa osikapa pound 2 na $3.18 bụ $1.59 kwa pound. Akpa pound 5 na $8.45 bụ $1.69 kwa pound. N'ebe a, akpa nke nta bụ nke ka mma ịzụ. Ọtụtụ ụlọ ahịa na-ebipụta ọnụahịa otu unit n'obere mkpụrụ edemede n'akara ọnụahịa dị na shelf; lelee na akara abụọ ahụ na-eji otu unit ahụ.
Nke ka mma ịzụ na-aka mma naanị ma ọ bụrụ na ị ga-eji ya tupu ọ mebie, ma ị nwekwara ike ịkwụ ụgwọ ya n'izu a. Ọnụahịa otu unit na-enyekwa aka n'ọrụ, dị ka mgbe a na-azụ ngwa ọrụ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Dee ọnụahịa na nha nke ihe ọ bụla.
- Lelee na unit dabara (ounce na ounce).
- Kee: ọnụahịa / nha = ọnụahịa otu unit.
- Tụnyere: nke ọnụahịa otu unit ya dị ala bụ nke ka mma ịzụ.
- Jụọ: ọ̀ ga m eji ya niile, ọ̀ ga m enwe ike ịkwụ ya ugbu a?
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Ọnụahịa otu unit (unit price): ọnụ otu unit, dị ka otu ounce ma ọ bụ otu pound.
- Ounce (oz): obere unit ịdị arọ; ounce 16 na-eme 1 pound.
- Pound (lb): unit ịdị arọ hà nhata ounce 16.
- Akara ọnụahịa shelf (shelf tag): akara ọnụahịa dị na shelf ụlọ ahịa; ọ na-egosikarị ọnụahịa otu unit.
Nwaa ugbu a: Omume (azịza dị n'okpuru): (1) Akwa 12 na $3.60 ka ọ bụ akwa 18 na $5.04? (2) Mmanya mkpụrụ osisi (juice) 64 oz na $3.84 ka ọ bụ 128 oz na $6.40? Azịza: (1) $0.30 kwa akwa ma $0.28 kwa akwa: akwa 18 ka mma; (2) $0.06 kwa ounce ma $0.05 kwa ounce: 128 oz ka mma. Wee, n'ụlọ ahịa ma ọ bụ na weebụsaịtị ụlọ ahịa, chọta ọnụahịa otu unit nke ihe 3 ị na-azụkarị na nha abụọ ma dee nke ka mma ịzụ. Nke a ga-aba na mpempe ọrụ ikpeazụ gị.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịchọta ọnụahịa otu unit ma họrọ nke ka mma ịzụ, ma mara mgbe nha ka ukwuu na-erughị ya.

check.q: Akpa nduku pound 10 na-efu $5.90. Gịnị bụ ọnụahịa otu unit?
Ncha A: mkpụrụ 3 na $2.70. Ncha B: mkpụrụ 8 na $8.00. Kedu nke ka mma ịzụ?
options: Ncha B, n'ihi na ọ nwere mkpụrụ karịa
Ha na-efu otu ego kwa mkpụrụ
Ncha B, n'ihi na ọ dị oke ọnụ
Ncha A, na $0.90 kwa mkpụrụ ma $1.00
check.why: $2.70 / 3 = $0.90 na $8.00 / 8 = $1.00, ya mere A na-efu obere ego kwa mkpụrụ.

chapters.name: Isi 2: Mgbakọ maka ọrụ na ego

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 4: Ịtụ ihe, ịgbanwe unit na ịgụ awa ọrụ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 4 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Gbanwee unit ma gbakọọ area na awa ọrụ maka ọrụ.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ọrụ dị ka ịtọ ala ime ụlọ ma ọ bụ idekọ oge ọrụ, ị ga-enwe ike ịgbanwe unit ma gbakọọ area ma ọ bụ awa ọrụ, na unit ziri ezi, na-agbago elu mgbe ị chọrọ ihe zuru ezu.
Unit a na-ejikarị na US: inch 12 = 1 foot, feet 3 = 1 yard, ounce 16 = 1 pound, pint 2 = 1 quart, quart 4 = 1 gallon. Ụfọdụ ọrụ na-eji metric: 1 inch = 2.54 centimeter, 1 kilogram dị ihe dị ka pound 2.2. Iji gbanwee unit buru ibu ka ọ bụrụ obere unit, mụbaa; iji gbanwee obere unit ka ọ bụrụ unit buru ibu, kee. Inch 90 / 12 = feet 7.5.
Area bụ oghere ihe dị larịị na-ekpuchi: ogologo x obosara, na square unit. Ime ụlọ feet 12 na feet 10 bụ 12 x 10 = 120 square feet. Ọ bụrụ na otu igbe ihe ntọ ala (flooring) na-ekpuchi 20 square feet, ị chọrọ 120 / 20 = igbe 6. Ndị ọrụ na-agbakwunyekarị ihe dị ka 10% maka ibipụ na mperi: 120 x 1.10 = 132, na 132 / 20 = 6.6. Ị pụghị ịzụ 0.6 nke igbe, ya mere gbagoo ELU ruo 7.
Awa ọrụ: gụọ site na mmalite ruo njedebe, wee wepụ ezumike a na-adịghị akwụ ụgwọ ya. Oge ọrụ site na 7:30 am ruo 4:00 pm bụ awa 8 1/2; wepụ nri ehihie nkeji 30 a na-adịghị akwụ ụgwọ ya, ọ bụ awa 8. Ọtụtụ kaadị oge (timecard) na-eji awa decimal: nkeji 15 = 0.25, nkeji 30 = 0.5, nkeji 45 = 0.75. Ụfọdụ ebe ọrụ na-eji elekere awa 24: 15:00 bụ 3:00 pm.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Dee ihe i nwere na unit ị chọrọ.
- Unit buru ibu gaa na obere: mụbaa. Obere gaa na nke buru ibu: kee.
- Area: ogologo x obosara, na square unit.
- Mgbe ị chọrọ ihe zuru ezu (igbe, akpa): gbagoo elu mgbe niile.
- Awa: oge njedebe wepụ oge mmalite, wepụ ezumike a na-adịghị akwụ ụgwọ ya; gbanwee nkeji ka ọ bụrụ decimal site n'ike ya na 60.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Unit: ihe ị na-eji atụ, dị ka inch, feet, pound ma ọ bụ awa.
- Ịgbanwe (convert): ịgbanwe ntụle site n'otu unit gaa na nke ọzọ.
- Area: oghere ihe dị larịị na-ekpuchi: ogologo ugboro obosara, na square unit.
- Square feet (sq ft): unit maka area mgbe ị na-atụ na feet.
- Metric: usoro ntụle a na-eji n'ọtụtụ ụwa: centimeter, meter, kilogram, liter.
- Awa decimal: oge e dere dị ka decimal, dị ka awa 7.75 maka awa 7 na nkeji 45.
Nwaa ugbu a: Omume (azịza dị n'okpuru): (1) Gbanwee feet 5 ka ọ bụrụ inch. (2) Gbanwee ounce 48 ka ọ bụrụ pound. (3) Ime ụlọ nchekwa bụ feet 9 na feet 14. Gịnị bụ area ya? (4) Agba na-ekpuchi ihe dị ka 350 square feet kwa gallon (na kom a e chepụtara). Ị ga-ekpuchi 800 square feet. Gallon ole ka ị ga-azụ? (5) Ị na-arụ ọrụ site na 6:45 am ruo 3:15 pm, nwere nri ehihie nkeji 30 a na-adịghị akwụ. Awa ole, dị ka decimal? Azịza: (1) inch 60; (2) pound 3; (3) 126 square feet; (4) 800 / 350 = 2.29, ya mere zụta gallon 3; (5) awa 8.5 wepụ 0.5 = awa 8.0.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịgbanwe unit, ịchọta area, ịgbago elu maka ihe zuru ezu na ịgụ awa ọrụ gị dị ka decimal.

check.q: Ị chọrọ akpa 4.2 nke ngwakọta concrete. Akpa ole ka ị ga-azụ?
check.why: Ị pụghị ịzụ akụkụ nke akpa, ya mere gbagoo elu ruo 5.

check.q: Awa 7 na nkeji 45 bụ awa ole dị ka decimal?

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 5: Ilele paystub gị
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 5 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Lelee awa, ọnụ ụgwọ, overtime, ihe e wepụrụ na net pay na paystub.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị paystub, ị ga-enwe ike ilele awa, ọnụ ụgwọ, overtime, ihe e wepụrụ na net pay otu ahịrị n'otu ahịrị, ka ahịrị ọ bụla dabara ruo cent, ma ọ bụ dee mperi ahụ ka ị jụọ maka ya.
Paystub na-egosi otu e si gbakọọ ụgwọ ọrụ gị. Gross pay bụ ihe i nwetara tupu e wepụ ihe ọ bụla. Deductions bụ ego e wepụrụ, dị ka ụtụ isi. Net pay bụ ihe ị na-enweta n'ezie: gross pay wepụ deductions. YTD pụtara year to date: mkpokọta ruo ugbu a n'afọ a.
Paystub omume (e chepụtara ya): awa 45 na $18.00 kwa awa. N'okpuru iwu gọọmentị etiti (federal), ndị ọrụ a na-akwụ kwa awa nke iwu ahụ kpuchiri na-enweta overtime maka awa karịrị 40 n'izu ọrụ, opekata mpe ugboro otu na ọkara. Ya mere: 40 x $18.00 = $720.00 ụgwọ nkịtị. Ọnụ overtime bụ $18.00 x 1.5 = $27.00, na 5 x $27.00 = $135.00. Gross pay = $855.00. Ụfọdụ steeti nwere iwu overtime ndị ọzọ; lelee ụlọ ọrụ ọrụ steeti gị.
Deductions na paystub a: Social Security 6.2% nke $855.00 = $53.01. Medicare 1.45% = $12.40. Ụtụ isi federal $60.00 na ụtụ isi steeti $20.00 (ndị a dabere na fọm W-4 gị na steeti gị; e chepụtara ha ebe a). Mkpokọta deductions = $145.41. Net pay = $855.00 - $145.41 = $709.59.
Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị ezighi ezi, dee ụbọchị ụgwọ, ahịrị ahụ na ihe ị tụrụ anya ya, wee buru ụzọ jụọ payroll ma ọ bụ onye isi gị. Ọ bụrụ na e mezighị ya, ị nwere ike ịkpọtụrụ ụlọ ọrụ ọrụ steeti gị ma ọ bụ Wage and Hour Division nke U.S. Department of Labor. Debe paystub gị, ma kpuchie ọnụọgụ Social Security gị tupu i gosi onye ọ bụla.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Tụnyere awa ahụ na ndekọ nke gị banyere awa i ji rụọ ọrụ.
- Ụgwọ nkịtị: ruo awa 40 x ọnụ ụgwọ gị.
- Overtime: awa karịrị 40 x (ọnụ ụgwọ x 1.5), ma ọ bụrụ na iwu ahụ kpuchiri gị.
- Gross pay = ụgwọ nkịtị + overtime + ụgwọ ọ bụla ọzọ.
- Gbakọọ deductions niile.
- Net pay = gross pay - mkpokọta deductions. Ọ̀ dabara na paystub ahụ?
- Ọ bụrụ na ọ dabaghị, dee ya ma jụọ payroll.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Paystub: akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ ndekọ n'ịntanetị na-egosi otu e si gbakọọ ụgwọ ọrụ gị.
- Gross pay: ihe i nwetara tupu e wepụ ihe ọ bụla.
- Net pay: ihe ị na-ebu ala mgbe e wepụchara deductions; a na-akpọkwa ya take-home pay.
- Deduction: ego e wepụrụ n'ụgwọ ọrụ gị, dị ka ụtụ isi ma ọ bụ inshọransị.
- Overtime: ụgwọ mgbakwunye, opekata mpe ugboro 1.5 nke ọnụ ụgwọ gị, maka awa karịrị 40 n'izu ọrụ nke iwu federal kpuchiri.
- YTD (year to date): mkpokọta site na Jenụwarị 1 ruo ụgwọ ọrụ a.
- W-4: fọm ị na-enye onye were gị n'ọrụ nke na-ekpebi ego ụtụ isi federal a ga-ewepụ.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- U.S. Department of Labor: Overtime pay (n'asụsụ bekee)
- IRS Topic 751: Social Security and Medicare withholding rates (n'asụsụ bekee)
Nwaa ugbu a: Omume (azịza dị n'okpuru): I rụrụ ọrụ awa 42 na $16.00 kwa awa. Deductions: Social Security 6.2%, Medicare 1.45%, ụtụ isi federal $45.00, ụtụ isi steeti $15.00 (e chepụtara). Chọta (1) ụgwọ nkịtị, (2) ụgwọ overtime, (3) gross pay, (4) mkpokọta deductions, (5) net pay. Azịza: (1) $640.00; (2) 2 x $24.00 = $48.00; (3) $688.00; (4) $42.66 + $9.98 + $45.00 + $15.00 = $112.64; (5) $575.36. Wee lelee ezi paystub nke gị n'otu ụzọ ahụ, kpuchie ọnụọgụ nzuzo.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ilele ahịrị ọ bụla nke paystub ma mara ihe ị ga-eme ma ọ bụrụ na ihe adabaghị.

check.q: Gross pay bụ $600.00, mkpokọta deductions bụ $95.00. Gịnị bụ net pay?
Ị na-enweta $20.00 kwa awa, iwu overtime federal kpuchikwara gị. Gịnị bụ ọnụ overtime gị?

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 6: Ịhazi budget kwa ọnwa site n'ụgwọ ọrụ gị
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 6 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Hazie budget kwa ọnwa nwere ego nchekwa nke na-eme ka mmefu ghara ịgafe ego na-abata.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ụgwọ ọrụ na-abịa mgbe niile, ị ga-enwe ike ịhazi budget kwa ọnwa nwere ego nchekwa ma mee ka mmefu ghara ịgafe ego na-abata, ka e dee ụdị mmefu ọ bụla ma lelee mkpokọta.
Budget bụ atụmatụ maka ego gị. Malite na net pay (take-home) kwa ọnwa. Ọnwa dị ntakịrị ogologo karịa izu 4, ya mere emela naanị ụgwọ izu ugboro 4. A na-akwụ kwa izu: net kwa izu x 52 / 12. A na-akwụ kwa izu abụọ: net x 26 / 12. Ihe atụ: $700 kwa izu x 52 = $36,400 kwa afọ, / 12 = $3,033.33 kwa ọnwa.
Depụta mmefu gị: buru ụzọ dee mkpa (ụlọ, ọkụ na mmiri, nri, njem, ekwentị, nlekọta ụmụaka, ụgwọ kacha nta a ga-akwụ na ụgwọ i ji), wee ego nchekwa, wee ihe ị chọrọ. Ihe atụ: ụlọ $1,200, ọkụ na mmiri $150, ekwentị $50, nri $400, njem $200, ụgwọ $150, ego nchekwa $150. Mkpokọta bụ $2,300, nke na-ahapụ $733.33 maka mkpa ndị ọzọ na ihe ị chọrọ.
Iwu ahụ: mkpokọta mmefu (gụnyere ego nchekwa) ga-adị nhata ma ọ bụ dị obere karịa ego na-abata. Ọ bụrụ na ọ karịrị, wepụ otu ihe ị chọrọ, belata otu ụgwọ, ma ọ bụ chọta ego ọzọ. Lelee mkpokọta site n'ịgbakọ ha ugboro abụọ, ma ọ bụ site na kalkuleta.
Soro ya otu ọnwa. Dee ihe ị na-emefu n'ezie, wee tụnyere ya na atụmatụ gị ma gbanwee ya. Akwụkwọ "Your Money, Your Goals" nke Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) n'efu nwere mpempe ọrụ ị nwere ike ibipụta.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Chọta net pay kwa ọnwa (kwa izu x 52 / 12, ma ọ bụ kwa izu abụọ x 26 / 12).
- Depụta mkpa: ụlọ, ọkụ na mmiri, nri, njem, ekwentị, nlekọta ụmụaka, ụgwọ kacha nta.
- Tinye ahịrị ego nchekwa, ọ bụrụgodị obere.
- Tinye ihe ị chọrọ n'ikpeazụ.
- Mkpokọta mmefu ga-adị nhata ma ọ bụ n'okpuru ego na-abata.
- Soro ya otu ọnwa ma gbanwee ya.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Budget: atụmatụ maka otu ị ga-esi jiri ego gị kwa ọnwa.
- Ego na-abata (income): ego na-abata, dị ka net pay gị.
- Mmefu (expense): ego na-apụ, dị ka ụgwọ ụlọ ma ọ bụ nri.
- Mmefu na-adịgide (fixed expense): mmefu nke na-adị otu kwa ọnwa, dị ka ụgwọ ụlọ.
- Mmefu na-agbanwe (variable expense): mmefu nke na-agbanwe kwa ọnwa, dị ka nri ma ọ bụ mmanụ ụgbọala.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- CFPB: Your Money, Your Goals, akwụkwọ mmụta mmefu ego n'efu (n'asụsụ bekee)
Nwaa ugbu a: Mechaa ọrụ ikpeazụ gị. Jiri net pay sitere na paystub gị na Nkuzi 5 (ma ọ bụ nke gị) ma gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ ego na-abata kwa ọnwa. Dee budget nwere mkpa, ahịrị ego nchekwa na ihe ị chọrọ. Gbakọọ ya ugboro abụọ. Ọ bụrụ na mmefu karịrị ego na-abata, gbanwee ya ruo mgbe ọ dabara. Tinye nlele paystub gị, budget na ntụnyere ọnụahịa otu unit 3 n'otu peeji: "Mpempe Mgbakọ Ọrụ na Ego" gị.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịgbanwe ụgwọ ọrụ ka ọ bụrụ ego na-abata kwa ọnwa ma hazie budget nke dabara ma nwee ego nchekwa.
Otu e si enyocha ọrụ ikpeazụ gị:
Ihe anyị na-ele anya Ọ bụbeghị O ruru O karịrị E lelere paystub E leleghị ụfọdụ ahịrị, ma ọ bụ e nwere mperi mgbakọ na gross ma ọ bụ net pay. E lelere awa, ọnụ ụgwọ, overtime, deductions na net pay; ahịrị ọ bụla dabara ruo cent ma ọ bụ e dere mperi ahụ. Na-edekwa ihe a ga-agwa payroll maka mperi ọ bụla na ebe a ga-aga ọzọ. Ego na-abata kwa ọnwa E jiri 4 mụbaa ụgwọ kwa izu, ma ọ bụ e jiri gross pay kama net. A chọtara net pay kwa ọnwa site na x 52 / 12 ma ọ bụ x 26 / 12. Na-egosi otu o si gbakọọ ya ma lelee ya n'ụzọ ọzọ. Budget dabara Mmefu karịrị ego na-abata, ma ọ bụ enweghị ahịrị ego nchekwa. E depụtara mkpa, ego nchekwa na ihe a chọrọ; mmefu nhata ma ọ bụ n'okpuru ego na-abata; e lelere mkpokọta. Gụnyere atụmatụ iso ezi mmefu na ụbọchị a ga-enyocha ya. Ọnụahịa otu unit Ntụnyere erughị 3, ma ọ bụ unit adabaghị. Ntụnyere 3 nwere ọnụahịa otu unit ziri ezi na akara nke ka mma ịzụ. Na-ekwu mgbe nha ka ukwuu abụghị nhọrọ ka mma na ihe mere. Percent Azịza omume maka mbelata, ụtụ isi, tip ma ọ bụ mmụba ụgwọ na-ezighi ezi ọtụtụ mgbe. Opekata mpe 4 n'ime omume percent 5 ziri ezi, ruo cent. Nwere ike ịkọwara onye ọzọ ụzọ dị mfe ahụ (10%, wee wulite). Iji gafee: Ruru eru ma ọ bụ Karịrị n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị bụ Ọ ruchabeghị, megharịa akụkụ ahụ site na nzọụkwụ nkuzi ahụ ma lelee ya ọzọ.

check.q: Ị na-ebu ala $500 kwa izu. Gịnị bụ ego na-abata kwa ọnwa?
check.why: $500 x 52 / 12 = $2,166.67; ịmụba ya na 4 na-ahapụ ụbọchị ndị fọdụrụ.

check.q: Mmefu i zubere karịrị ego na-abata gị $50. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Hapụ atụmatụ ahụ ma tụọ anya
Wepụ ahịrị ego nchekwa ma leghara ya anya
Wepụ ma ọ bụ belata ụfọdụ mmefu ruo mgbe mmefu dabara
check.why: Budget na-arụ ọrụ naanị mgbe mmefu dị nhata ma ọ bụ n'okpuru ego na-abata.
